note: sources lists every official URL the dataset cites. 'status' is the HTTP result of this host; 'provenance_*' and 'content_status' come from the most recent real fetch. 'facts-changed' means a money amount, date, time or entry-rule word printed on that page differs from the last verified capture, and every row citing it is listed in data/changes.json. A page that merely re-renders (cosmetic-changed) is recorded but marks no row. 'unreachable' means the host did not answer from the machine that ran the check; it does not by itself mean the page changed.
